$comment: Instrument catalogue for the AI regulatory-environment models. Data, not a run input: the engine reads only params/*.json. Each params slot names the instruments it aggregates by id. `slot: null` marks posture-setting instruments that impose no compliance duty themselves and act through p_in_force, state_support or compute instead. `confidence` grades the catalogue entry, not the law: low/medium entries come from secondary trackers and should be verified against primary text before anything is graded against them.

slots.filing: Ex-ante approval or registration before launch
slots.content: Content labeling, provenance, takedown, synthetic media
slots.data: Personal data, data security, cross-border data
slots.trade: Export controls and trade restrictions borne by domestic AI firms

instruments.name: EO 14179 — Removing Barriers to American Leadership in AI
instruments.note: Revoked EO 14110 (Biden). Sets the deregulatory federal posture; carries no compliance duty, so it binds no slot.

instruments.name: America's AI Action Plan
instruments.note: Infrastructure, export promotion and deregulation agenda; drives state_support and permitting, not compliance.

instruments.name: EO 14365 — Ensuring a National Policy Framework for AI
instruments.note: Directs the DOJ AI Litigation Task Force (stood up 2026-01-09) to challenge state AI laws, Commerce to list 'onerous' state laws, BEAD funding conditions, FCC disclosure standard. Cannot itself preempt; it drives p_in_force on the frontier and highrisk slots. Carves out child safety and state procurement.
instruments.source: Paul Hastings client alert; Baker Botts Jan 2026 update

instruments.name: Great American AI Act (discussion draft)
instruments.note: 269-page bipartisan draft released 2026-06-04; would preempt state AI development laws for three years. Not passed as of Aug 2026. The federal-preemption scenario binds its effect.

instruments.name: California SB 53 — Transparency in Frontier AI Act
instruments.note: Frontier developers publish safety frameworks, report critical safety incidents to OES, whistleblower protections; civil penalties via AG.

instruments.name: New York RAISE Act
instruments.note: Frontier-model safety and incident-reporting duties; signed Dec 2025 with chapter amendments. Effective date not confirmed here.

instruments.name: Colorado AI Act (SB 24-205)
instruments.note: Developer/deployer duties for high-risk systems making consequential decisions. Delayed from 2026-02-01 to 2026-06-30; April 2026 AG agreed not to enforce pending rulemaking not yet begun; US intervened in xAI v. Weiser; Polis workgroup replacement framework pending.
instruments.source: Taft Law bulletin 2026; Clark Hill; statescoop

instruments.name: Illinois HB 3773 — AI in employment decisions
instruments.note: Amends the Human Rights Act: discriminatory use of AI in employment decisions is a civil-rights violation; notice duty.

instruments.name: NYC Local Law 144 — Automated employment decision tools
instruments.note: Bias audits and candidate notice for AEDTs.

instruments.name: Texas Responsible AI Governance Act (HB 149)
instruments.note: Mostly government-use duties plus prohibited-practice bans for private actors; AG enforcement with cure period; regulatory sandbox.

instruments.name: CCPA regulations — automated decision-making technology
instruments.note: ADMT pre-use notice, opt-out and access rights for significant decisions; risk assessments phased in through 2027+.

instruments.name: FDA pre-market review of AI-enabled device software
instruments.note: 510(k)/De Novo/PMA review with predetermined change control plans. The only material ex-ante gate on AI in the US, and only for medical devices.
instruments.source: FDA AI-enabled device software functions guidance

instruments.name: TAKE IT DOWN Act
instruments.note: Criminalises non-consensual intimate imagery incl. AI-generated; platforms must remove within 48h of notice (platform duty from May 2026).

instruments.name: California AI Transparency Act (SB 942, as amended by AB 853)
instruments.note: Covered GenAI providers offer detection tools and embed latent disclosures; operative date pushed to Aug 2026.

instruments.name: California SB 243 — companion chatbots
instruments.note: Disclosure, minor-protection and self-harm protocol duties for companion chatbot operators; private right of action.

instruments.name: State election-deepfake disclosure laws
instruments.note: Disclosure/prohibition of deceptive AI media near elections; several enjoined on First Amendment grounds.

instruments.name: State comprehensive privacy laws
instruments.note: Profiling opt-outs, DPIAs for high-risk processing, sensitive-data consent.

instruments.name: FTC Act Section 5 enforcement on AI
instruments.note: Deceptive AI claims, algorithmic disgorgement remedies. Lower intensity under current leadership.

instruments.name: DOJ rule on bulk sensitive data to countries of concern (28 CFR 202)
instruments.note: Prohibits/restricts transactions giving China and other countries of concern access to bulk US sensitive data, incl. via AI training data deals.

instruments.name: EAR advanced computing and semiconductor controls
instruments.note: ECCN 3A090/4A090 controls with 2023 and 2024 expansions; Blackwell-class denied for China. The 2025 AI Diffusion Rule was rescinded in May 2025.

instruments.name: BIS licensing policy — H200 / MI325X to China case-by-case
instruments.note: Moves H200/MI325X from presumption of denial to case-by-case for direct US exports only; China volume ≤50% of US end-use sales; applicant certifies no US-supply diversion; 25% Section 232 tariff.
instruments.source: IAPS; Institute for Security and Technology primer

instruments.name: BIS guidance — China/Macau-parented entities
instruments.note: License required for advanced computing items to any entity whose ultimate parent is headquartered in China or Macau, wherever located.

instruments.name: AI OVERWATCH Act (H.R. 6875)
instruments.note: Statutory two-year Blackwell export ban + congressional veto over licenses; passed committee 42-2. Floor status unconfirmed.

instruments.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework + CAISI
instruments.note: Voluntary; referenced as a safe harbour by Colorado and Texas. US AISI renamed Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) in 2025.

instruments.name: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services
instruments.note: Public-facing GenAI providers must file, perform security assessment, ensure lawful training data, and moderate content.

instruments.name: Algorithm filing system (algorithm registry)
instruments.note: Recommendation/deep-synthesis/GenAI algorithms with public-opinion or social-mobilisation attributes must register; 1,112 GenAI services filed and 731 apps/features registered by 2026-08-31.
instruments.source: CAC filing announcements; Digital Policy Alert

instruments.name: Security assessment for services with public-opinion attributes
instruments.note: Pre-launch security assessment, operationalised for GenAI through TC260-003 (corpus, model and safety-test requirements).

instruments.name: Provisions on Algorithmic Recommendation
instruments.note: User opt-out of personalisation, bans on price discrimination by profile, worker-protection duties for dispatch algorithms.

instruments.name: Interim Measures for Anthropomorphic AI Interaction Services
instruments.note: Duties for AI companions/human-like interaction services: addiction safeguards, minors, emotional-manipulation limits.

instruments.name: PIPL Article 24 — automated decision-making
instruments.note: Transparency and fairness in automated decisions; right to refuse decisions made solely by automation.

instruments.name: Regulations on the Protection of Minors Online
instruments.note: Minor modes, time limits and content duties extended to AI services.

instruments.name: AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0
instruments.note: Risk taxonomy incl. frontier/loss-of-control risks; recommended, not mandatory.

instruments.name: National standards on GenAI security (GB/T series)
instruments.note: Basic security requirements for GenAI services, pre-training/fine-tuning data security, annotation security.

instruments.name: Measures for Labeling AI-Generated Synthetic Content
instruments.note: Explicit labels and implicit metadata watermarks; platforms must detect and label.

instruments.name: GB 45438-2025 — labeling method for AI-generated content
instruments.note: Mandatory national standard implementing the Labeling Measures.

instruments.name: Provisions on Deep Synthesis Internet Information Services
instruments.note: Labeling, real-name verification, and content-security duties for synthetic media.

instruments.name: Personal Information Protection Law
instruments.note: Consent, purpose limitation, PIA, cross-border transfer mechanisms.

instruments.name: Data Security Law
instruments.note: Data classification, important-data protection, national-security review of data activity.

instruments.name: Network Data Security Management Regulations
instruments.note: Operationalises PIPL/DSL incl. duties for platforms and important-data processors.

instruments.name: Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows
instruments.note: Relaxed thresholds for security assessments on outbound data.

instruments.name: Cybersecurity Law amendment (AI provisions)
instruments.note: Adds AI-governance and AI-safety support clauses; raises penalties. AI-specific operative text not verified here.

instruments.name: Catalogue of Technologies Prohibited or Restricted from Export
instruments.note: Covers recommendation algorithms and other AI technologies; revised 2023 and 2025.

instruments.name: Rare-earth and dual-use export controls
instruments.note: October 2025 expansion suspended for one year under the November 2025 US–China arrangement; earlier controls remain.

instruments.name: Opinions on Deepening the AI+ Action
instruments.note: Targets >70% penetration of intelligent terminals/agents by 2027 and >90% by 2030; drives state_support, not compliance.

instruments.name: Comprehensive AI Law
instruments.note: On State Council legislative plans since 2023; not adopted as of Oct 2026. The ai-law scenario binds its effect.

instruments.name: Informal block on H200 imports / domestic-chip steering
instruments.note: Customs holds and window guidance steering buyers to domestic accelerators; binds compute.import_realization rather than a slot.
instruments.source: IAPS; Institute for Security and Technology
